column1: # Hand-edits manifest — consumed by scripts/check-hand-edits.sh
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   1. category     — "preserve" | "verify" | "preserve-file" | "verify-file"
#                       preserve:      a pattern that MUST be present in the staged file (errors if missing)
#                       verify:        a pattern we expect; warns (not errors) if missing — human review
#                       preserve-file: a whole file that must survive regen (copied baseline→staging by 'preserve' mode)
#                       verify-file:   a whole file that ought to survive — warn if absent
#   2. version_api  — "v1" or "v2" (matches V1/V2 stage dir suffix)
#   3. file         — path relative to the v1/v2 dir
#   4. pattern      — a fixed string to grep -F for in the file (ignored for *-file rows)
#   5. ref          — commit SHA(s) and short description
# Lines starting with '#' are comments. Empty lines ignored. Tabs only — no spaces.
# Authoritative cross-reference: HAND_EDITS.md

# rows are 'verify' (warn-only) rather than 'preserve' (error). preserve-file
# rows still apply because regression tests live outside the generator's reach.
